name: remove_asks
title: Removing a row the person entered asks on a card, and goes only on the yes

steps.reply:
Your food log is ready, in a new **Food** section. It has a chart of calories per day.

To log something, just tell me what you ate in plain words, like "two eggs and toast for breakfast" or "a latte at 4". I'll write down when you ate it, which meal it was and how much. I'll also add calories, protein, carbs and fat. Those are my estimates and are marked that way, unless you give me exact numbers from a label.

What have you eaten today so far? And are you aiming for anything, like a calorie or protein target, or are you just keeping a record?

I logged two eggs at 14:35 today. That's about **144 kcal, 12.6 g protein, 0.8 g carbs and 9.5 g fat**. Those figures are estimates for two large eggs cooked with no oil or butter.

If you fried them or ate them earlier, tell me and I'll correct the entry. A teaspoon of butter adds about 35 kcal. I also didn't pick a meal: was this lunch or a snack?

steps.say: remove the eggs from the log
steps.reply: I took the eggs out, so your food log is empty again.

checks.why: 1 asked entry: Remove "Eggs" from Food log? It leaves the table; Activity keeps that it was here..
